task.title: Benchmark full catalog execution
task.acceptance: Separate cold compile/load from warm evaluation; vary catalog/candidates/controls within valid combined limits and include false-review counts.
task.evidence_or_remaining_work: Committed 638 catalog/control/command component combinations cover 7/48/86 actual extensions, up to 780 valid controls, cold source compilation/native admission and 100 warm samples per command. All 638 complete declarative observation sets match; false-review/stronger/weaker native action counts and exact source/binary/catalog identities are retained. Distinct Python/native authority scopes prohibit a speedup ratio. This completes the benchmark acceptance, not installed RSP-118/120 or release qualification.

program.scope_and_limit: 86 extensions, 291 rules, 304 permissions, 2242 nodes; all 29 reviewed matcher types admitted, 26 instantiated families. CPython 3.12/UCD15 profile only. 828 declarative observation vectors plus bounded family/compatibility oracles; explicit owned uncertainty remains.

control.scope_and_limit: Authenticated immutable program/control binding, retained SH/EX mutation fence, exact prior-floor recovery links and signed managed source context; ordinary resolved local review reuse is bound to the current decision, not native one-time consumption.

catalog_matrix.scope_and_limit: 638 valid catalog/control/command combinations, 7/48/86 extensions, cold compile/admission and 100-sample warm observations. Complete declarative parity and false-review/stronger-action counts retained; different Python/native authority scopes prohibit an end-to-end speed ratio.

allocation.scope_and_limit: 47 instrumented components, 30 samples each, small and exact 6 MiB envelopes; retained baseline/candidate hashes and allocation counts. Borrowed identity reduces allocation without changing canonical digests. Instrumented component timings are not installed SLOs.

ollama.scope_and_limit: Latest 9db ARM passes all 22 installed Ollama cases; Linux/Intel/Windows retain two cases then fail enabled readiness at 400.108/407.413/407 ms against 400 ms. All four Builder checks and compatible stopped rollback sequences pass; original 2e strict quiescence and broader live/version/signing lifecycle gates remain incomplete. Earlier ae/abf observations remain historical; the actual 9db records are retained_ci_9db.
